genre.zh: 設計雜誌（Wallpaper*）的工作室報導
genre.en: a Wallpaper* design-magazine studio feature: a real working studio, screens and sketches, natural light

s: a phone held up filling the frame, its screen showing a finished ad, in front of a tomato-red roll-up shutter of a small night-market stall, hard late-afternoon sun from the left throwing the phone's sharp shadow across the corrugated metal

a laptop open and huge in frame on a scarred wooden workbench in a small workshop, deep-sea-blue painted wall behind, a single hard shaft of window light from the right cutting a crisp shadow across the keyboard and sawdust

a phone propped against a terracotta-orange tiled counter of a neighborhood shop, its screen glowing with a vertical video, hard overhead sun from the doorway casting a long sharp shadow of the phone across the tiles
a tablet leaning on a mint-green bathroom-tile ledge of a barbershop, close and large in frame, hard side light from a window on the left drawing a clean diagonal shadow over the grout lines

a laptop with its screen split into several brand dashboards, wedged between stacked shipping boxes on a packing table, tomato-red wall behind, hard sun from a high left window throwing the box and laptop shadows sharply across the kraft-paper surface
the phone held in a hand in front of a deep-sea-blue shop-front, screen showing a generated ad image, hard noon sun from above-right with a crisp shadow of the hand and phone on the wall

the laptop big in the frame on a wooden workbench in a small product studio, terracotta-orange wall behind, one hard beam from the right window slicing a long shadow across the keyboard and the product samples next to it

a tablet showing a grid of brand profiles leaning against a mint-green tiled counter in a tea shop, hard morning light from the left window casting sharp shadows of the tablet and cups across the tile

the phone filling the frame, its screen showing a smiling virtual influencer mid-video, held up in front of a terracotta-orange night-market stall wall, hard low sun from the right throwing a sharp shadow of the phone and fingers across the brick

a phone on a tripod clamped to a metal shelf in a small clothing shop, screen showing a digital host talking to camera, tomato-red wall behind, hard light from the street door on the left drawing a long crisp shadow across the floor

the laptop open on a salon counter with the virtual host's face on screen, deep-sea-blue wall behind, a hard beam from a window on the right laying the laptop's shadow across the counter's worn laminate

a phone leaning on a mint-green painted market stool, screen showing a short vertical video of a virtual influencer, hard afternoon sun from the left casting sharp stool and phone shadows on the concrete floor

the laptop wide open showing a clean shop website, placed on a wooden counter of a small bakery front, tomato-red wall behind, hard sun from the left window throwing its sharp shadow across the flour-dusted wood
a phone held large in frame showing a mobile website with an order button, in front of a deep-sea-blue shop shutter, hard noon sun from above-left with crisp shadows of the phone and hand

the laptop standing on a terracotta-orange tiled workshop bench with tools nearby, screen showing a finished website, hard light from a doorway on the right casting a long sharp shadow across the tiles
a tablet showing a booking page propped on a mint-green tiled barbershop shelf, hard side window light from the left drawing a clean diagonal shadow over the tile and the scissors beside it
